factions.name: Ostrander Concern
factions.description: The company that held the Reach as a mining concession until the Withdrawal of 2291.

factions.name: Cutters' Union
factions.description: The glass-cutters of Shaft Nine and the other Tallow shafts, organising against the Concession.

factions.name: Contract Pilots
factions.description: The debt-bound tug pilots who haul glass from Hollin to Anchorage.

factions.name: Compact of the Reach
factions.description: The Reach's government after the Concession, seated in the Assembly at Tallow Under.

factions.name: Compact Navy
factions.description: The Compact's fleet, six years into the Severance.

factions.name: Wardens of the Throat
factions.description: The order that reads the Needle and keeps the Keeping. At the Anchorhold in 2608; at the Anchor, diminished, in 2937.

factions.name: Shoals Free League
factions.description: The outer habitats in revolt against the Draw.

factions.name: Keepers of the Thirtieth
factions.description: The nine drawn for the Thirtieth Keeping.

factions.name: The Lantern
factions.description: The Lamplighter's militia and congregation, who hold Tallow and preach the Great Keeping.

factions.name: Bone-pickers
factions.description: The salvagers who strip the Returns in the Ossuary.
